data_quality.note: 16 of 723 historical constituents have no yfinance price history (delisted or acquired names, plus identifiers yfinance does not resolve — e.g. 1812473D, APY, CHK, COG, DISHR, DWDP, FRC, HOLX US). Daily n_with_price vs n_constituents lets Step 3 quarantine suspect periods.
